proof_roadmap: Polarizations identify with CM squarefree ideals dual to rainbow ideals.
Truncation and Tor-degree induction force all colourwise intersection ideals to stay linear.
Induction on colours and constructive decomposition establish rainbow constructibility.
Alexander duality and codimension-one combinatorics permit Björner ball criterion.
difficulty_reason: The nonroutine work is the retained linear-resolution-to-constructibility mechanism in native1692–1877: multigraded truncation controls all subsums, Tor-degree arguments and induction force intersections to remain linear, and colour-by-colour recursion reconstructs the rainbow ideal as constructible. Only then does duality and codimension-one combinatorics yield the ball conclusion. The author core is fully included rather than replaced by an external theorem; venue and length are not the basis.

ALCO2 Theorem1.13 proves normality of quiver lower-bound cluster algebras; its special vertex-decomposable model is not this universal polarization theorem.
arXiv2610.09926v1 is an eleven-vertex graph census separating CM/shellability/vertex-decomposability, not rainbow ideal constructibility.
arXiv2601.20233v1 MainLem is local-cohomology diagram functoriality, not a ball theorem.
arXiv2603.17776v2 thm:3 computes Betti numbers of chordal clique-complex skeletons, a different conclusion.
arXiv2609.18071v1 concerns CM conormal/Kähler modules, not polarization topology.
